summary.name: Junie
summary.one_liner: Junie is JetBrains' AI coding agent that runs from the terminal, IDEs, GitHub, and GitLab, and supports many models via bring-your-own-key.
use_cases: Running a coding agent from the terminal across multiple projects
Automating Spring Boot upgrades and code migrations
Running AI tasks from GitHub issues or pull requests
Planning features before implementation with editable plans
Adding test coverage to a codebase
Enforcing team coding standards and conventions in AI-assisted work
summary.what_it_does: Junie is a coding agent that can be run directly from a terminal by pasting a command, and it also works inside the IntelliJ IDEA engine to use the IDE's code intelligence and tooling. It supports 10+ models via bring-your-own-key and can run on locally hosted models. An Advanced Plan Mode writes requirements, design, and delivery stages into editable, committable files in .junie/plans before code changes, and the user can approve or redirect. Users can steer the agent mid-task, and key actions can be reviewed and confirmed. It can also run tasks from GitHub issues/PRs and GitLab issues/MRs, and tasks can be started on a laptop and monitored from a web app.
notable: Plan mode writes editable, committable plans in .junie/plans and can use a different model for planning vs implementation
Bring-your-own-key support for 10+ models plus local model support
Async execution via CLI with web app monitoring
Persistent team guidelines and Agent Skills packages with shared /commands across CLI and IDE via ACP
caveats: Paid tiers beyond the free plan: $8.33 and $25.00 per user per month, with AI usage billed separately
Free tier includes only 10 AI Credits per 30 days; cloud credit limits apply to coding agent use
Listed as paid in the directory entry, though the page offers a free tier
